SEWRPC's Regional Land Use-Transportation Plan for 1990, the refined Jurisdictional Highway System Plan for Milwaukee County-1990, and the Milwaukee Area Transit Plan all recommended a bus rapid transit system for the Milwaukee Metropolitan Area.

Since there are many people entirely dependent upon public transit, it is extremely important to provide fast, convenient, and economical mass transit service through the metropolitan area. The Milwaukee Area Transit Plan contains specific recommendations for a bus modified rapid transit system and improved local transit service for Milwaukee County. The proposed bus modified rapid transit service would have the flexibility to operate in mixed freeway traffic, provide a balanced modal system, and offer a high level of transportation. It also provides an alternative to continued automobile use.
